rows.en: (What should I do after school today?)

\p-san,
if you're free, shall we stop off somewhere?
Sure, where should we go?
I wonder if there's anywhere good...
Somewhere good, huh... Hmm...
What are you two up to?

Oh, Alto...
We were trying to decide where to stop off
on the way home. Know anywhere good?

...Beats me.
Why not just go to Nyan-Nyan?
Nanase and the others will be there anyway.
Good idea. Let's go to Nyan-Nyan, Luca.
Sounds good. Alto-senpai, why don't you come too?
Yeah, sure.
(I had a really fun time after school today!)
Somewhere good... Hmm...

Saotome-kun...
We were trying to decide where to stop off
on the way home. Know anywhere good?
Good idea. Let's go to Nyan-Nyan, Luca-kun.
(I had a really fun time after school today!)
*Yaaawn*......

That was a big yawn. You look sleepy,
\p-san.
I stayed up a bit late last night...
Is that so...
Oh, I know. Wait here a moment, okay?
Here you go, some coffee to wake you up.
Oh, thanks, Luca.
......Mm, this is good!

You made this yourself, right, Luca?
I think it's good enough to serve in a cafe.

I'm flattered to get that much praise.
Thank you very much.

There's a little trick to making
a good cup of coffee.
Huh~ Then teach me the trick sometime.
Just keep it a secret from everyone else.

(All right, thanks to Luca I'm wide awake.
Time to give the rest of my classes my all!)
Oh, thanks, Luca-kun.

You made this yourself, didn't you, Luca-kun?
I think it's good enough to serve in a cafe.
Huh~ Then will you teach me the trick sometime?

(All right, thanks to Luca-kun I'm wide awake.
I've gotta give the rest of my classes my all!)

(Even setting aside the grade-skipping,
he really doesn't look like a high schooler...)
rows.notes: Player watching Luca (he skipped a grade, as in c21156).

rows.en: Hmmm......
rows.notes: x6: the player thinking here; Hoshimura groaning in her sleep (nml_yui_015) and thinking (nml_yui_017). Neutral for all.

rows.en:
What's wrong, \p-san?
You look so troubled.

Well, I was just thinking that you
really don't look like a high schooler, Luca...
Geez~ Please don't treat me like a kid!
I'll have you know, I'm actually...
Luca-kuuun, here, have a candy.
Yaaay, thank you very much!

What I'm trying to say is... (clack clack)
that I'd like people not to judge others
by their looks... (clack clack)
rows.notes: korokoro: the hard candy rattling in Luca's mouth.

rows.en:
(Hard to take that seriously when he's
saying it with such a happy face...)

Well, I was just thinking that you
really don't look like a high schooler, Luca-kun...

(Hard to take that seriously when he's
saying it with such a happy face...)
(Hmm, this has been bugging me for a while...)

(Why does Luca wear shorts?
They suit him, so it's not a problem, but...)
Hey, Luca, got a sec?
What is it?
rows.notes: x4: Luca to the player here; also the player to Claire and to Klan in the White Day scenes (scd_com_722). Polite enough for both.

rows.en:
This has been bugging me for a while...
Why do you wear shorts?
W-Well, that's...

I-I'm sorry,
I just remembered something urgent, so I'll be going!
Ah, Luca...!

(Could those shorts actually be hiding
some incredible secret?)

(Why does Luca-kun wear shorts, I wonder?
They suit him, so it's not a problem, but...)
Hey, Luca-kun, got a sec?

This has been bugging me for a while...
Why do you wear shorts?
Ah, Luca-kun...!

(Could those shorts actually be hiding
some incredible secret?)

uncertain: c17912: 'korokoro' (candy rolling in the mouth) rendered as '(clack clack)'.
c17919 'nandesu?' is shared by Luca and by the player speaking to Claire/Klan on White Day: 'What is it?' fits all.
